# Sample a polar quarter circle

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Radius 2 over angles \[0,pi/4,pi/2\] gives x=\[2,sqrt(2),0\],y=\[0,sqrt(2),2\]. The oracle uses analytic constants with absolute/relative tolerance 1e-12.

## What this example demonstrates

Radius 2 over angles \[0,pi/4,pi/2\] gives x=\[2,sqrt(2),0\],y=\[0,sqrt(2),2\]. The oracle uses analytic constants with absolute/relative tolerance 1e-12.
